(c) A check that the worker's reads touched only approved customers (C5); scope of a call is also only available on named lines during the work, and the allowance covers about five reads. (d) A direct read of the live tables after the promotion, since every plan instrument reads the staged set, and the link to the live tables rests on the promotion's line alone.
